nodes.label: University of Bamenda Official Seal
nodes.description: Circular institutional emblem (gold ring on dark blue) of The University of Bamenda / Universite de Bamenda, Cameroon. Inner roundel shows a green mountain landscape (the Bamenda highlands) with an open white book and the abbreviation 'UBa' on a scroll; a banner across the base carries the motto. Functions as the academic branding/cover mark for the Masters project rather than as experimental data.

nodes.label: Motto: Knowledge, Probity, Entrepreneurship
nodes.description: Three-word institutional motto rendered on the banner at the foot of the seal, stating the university's declared values.
nodes.rationale: Placed on the outer banner (the most legible band of a small seal) so the values remain readable when the emblem is reduced to letterhead or thumbnail size.

nodes.label: Bilingual English/French Institutional Identity
nodes.description: The seal carries the institution's name twice, in English on the upper arc ('THE UNIVERSITY OF BAMENDA') and in French on the lower arc ('UNIVERSITE DE BAMENDA').
nodes.rationale: Duplicating the name in both official languages of Cameroon on a single ring makes the mark valid for documents submitted in either language, avoiding the need for two separate logos; the design cost is that the ring text is small and the two arcs mirror each other.
